= Non-proof fixtures

Files here are kept for reference only. They are *not* proofs, no CI job
type-checks them, and no proof-status row cites them.

`NeSyAssistTesting.idr`:: Moved from `src/abi/` by owner ruling on open
question A5. It does not parse. It states an empirical property of the neural
ranker, which a proof cannot establish, so it is not a proof obligation. If
that property is wanted, test it against the ranker; do not restore this file
to the ABI package.
